---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for OpenCAD UX
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**What problem does this solve for product-design work?**

**Describe the desired behaviour** (and, when applicable, how Fusion 360 or
another tool does it — describe the interaction, we will not copy assets)

**Ribbon/keys/settings impact**
- new ribbon button? new group? new shortcut? setting?
- Which FreeCAD command should it call (if known)?

**FreeCAD API feasibility**
If you know whether this is possible with the stock FreeCAD public API,
please say so (e.g. "PartDesign has no python reference-setter for X"). This
helps us plan python fallbacks or document limits.
